لَبَنٌ مُصْمِغٌ [app. Milk that is gummy; describing biestings not yet clear]. (TA voce صُعْرُورٌ, q. v.) ―
-b2- And شَاةٌ مُصْمِغَةٌ بِلِبَئِهَا, (O, TA,) in the copies of the K, erroneously, بِلَبَنِهَا, (TA,) A ewe, or she-goat, yielding fresh biestings on the first occasion of her being milked. (O, K, * TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
